Name: Easter Eggs and Chocolate Bunny Lucky Foot
Author: osmiacyril
Description:
Happy Easter to those who celebrate it, and happy four year anniversary of the first Dishonored DLC, The Knife of Dunwall, to those who don't!

This mod replaces the small white chicken egg, small brown chicken egg, and duck egg with colored eggs from the egg hunt event in spring. I also recolored the large white chicken egg and the large brown chicken egg to match their smaller counterparts and replaced the lucky foot with a foil-wrapped chocolate bunny.

To install:
1. Navigate to Content/Maps in your Stardew Valley directory.
2. Back up the springobjects.xnb file in that folder.
3. Replace that springobjects.xnb with the one included in the mod download.

Hope you all enjoy! If you like this mod, please consider checking out my other mods [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/qobs-mods.132217/]here[/url].
Check it out on the stardew valley forums [url=http://http://community.playstarbound.com/resources/easter-chicken-and-duck-eggs-and-chocolate-bunny-lucky-foot.4671/]here[/url].

Version History:
1.0: Original file. Caused an issue that caused crystals in the ice part of the mines to appear off-colored, due to me using an older version of xnb_node that could not handle semi-transparent sprites correctly.
1.1: Updated and current version. No longer causes the crystal color bug, so please download this one and replace the old springobjects.xnb with the new one to get it to work properly.
